practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 94% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.

practiceReport.beatComment: Risner was held out of practice all week due to injuries to both of his knees that he sustained in Week 10 against the Steelers. practiceReport.name: Joe Burrow
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 99% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Cleared without restrictive game-day designation
Coaching/beat trend (beat report): trending upward / optimistic to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: Burrow dealt with an illness during Week 11 prep, but with no injury tag the 2020 first overall pick has been officially cleared to play Monday night -- and per ESPN.com he is confident he will do so at "full strength." He's thrown at least three touchdowns in each of his last five outings, and over that span he has completed 77.6 percent of his passes for 1,624 yards, 20 touchdowns and three interceptions while turning 13 carries into 47 yards and two scores. The Bengals will face a Commanders defense that ranks 31st in the NFL in passing yards allowed per game (244.8) and 30th in red-zone touchdown rate (71.9 percent).

practiceReport.name: Tee Higgins
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 78% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Cleared without restrictive game-day designation
practiceReport.beatComment: It's a new "injury" for Higgins, but the full participation level suggests it's nothing serious after the wideout was managed late in last Sunday night's blowout win over the Steelers, per Kelsey Conway of The Cincinnati Enquirer. Higgins already has a fantasy-friendly 53 catches (on 73 targets) for 824 yards and six touchdowns through nine games. He's on pace for a career year in 2026.
